era: Arcade / Dreamcast / Wii / Switch / VR rhythm
summary: Sega's maraca-shaking rhythm series, from the NAOMI arcade and Dreamcast originals through modern Switch, Quest, and Apple Arcade revivals.

entries.title: Samba de Amigo
entries.definitive_edition: Samba de Amigo Ver. 2000 on Dreamcast

emulation.emulator: Flycast or Redream for Dreamcast; Dolphin for Wii comparison
emulation.notes: Original Dreamcast maracas are ideal; emulation is mainly for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Dreamcast Ver. 2000 presentation upscaled through emulator.

primary.why: The Japanese Dreamcast Ver. 2000 release is the most complete classic route: it adds 14 new songs, six downloadable songs for the home version, Hustle Mode, Survival, expanded Challenge goals, and extra home content.
primary.how_to_play: Play Samba de Amigo Ver. 2000 on Dreamcast with maraca controllers if possible, or via Dreamcast emulation for capture. Use the Wii version only for a motion-control remake comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Sega NAOMI arcade release with maraca controls.
all_releases.reason: skip: historically first, but Ver. 2000 Dreamcast is the more complete classic package.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Dreamcast home release with maraca controller support.
all_releases.reason: skip: excellent home route, but the later Dreamcast Ver. 2000 release adds more songs and modes.

all_releases.fidelity: Samba de Amigo Ver. 2000 arcade upgrade.
all_releases.reason: skip: upgraded arcade route, but the Dreamcast Ver. 2000 home version has the stronger complete-package case.

all_releases.fidelity: Samba de Amigo Ver. 2000 Dreamcast release with added songs and modes.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete classic version while preserving Dreamcast maraca-controller play.

all_releases.fidelity: Wii motion-control revival using Wii Remote/Nunchuk input.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful remake comparison, but not the most complete classic-maraca route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Dreamcast Ver. 2000 is both the strongest classic control route and the most complete documented classic package.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Wii version is a later motion-control revival, not a straight remaster of the Dreamcast maraca-controller experience.

entries.title: Samba de Amigo: Party Central
entries.definitive_edition: Nintendo Switch release with current updates/DLC

emulation.notes: Use Joy-Con shake controls and install updates before capture.

primary.why: Party Central is the Switch revival with over 40 songs, World Party online play, local two-player modes, StreamiGo missions, and post-launch DLC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the updated Nintendo Switch version with a pair of Joy-Con controllers for the intended shake controls; install current updates and DLC packs if covering the full song catalog.

all_releases.reason: primary: only official platform for Party Central.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Party Central is a Switch release; Apple Arcade and Quest received distinct named versions.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern sequel/revival rather than a remaster of the Dreamcast game.

entries.title: Samba de Amigo: Virtual Party

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Quest headset-dependent, with Quest 3 preferred within the supported family.

primary.why: Virtual Party is the dedicated VR version, officially listed for Meta Quest 3, Quest 2, and Quest Pro with one-player and online eight-player support.
primary.how_to_play: Play the updated Meta Quest version on Quest 3 for the cleanest standalone headset route; Quest 2 and Quest Pro are supported alternatives.

all_releases.fidelity: Standalone VR/MR release for the Meta Quest family.
all_releases.reason: primary: only official platform family for Virtual Party.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Quest family is the only official Virtual Party platform family.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is the VR/MR version of the 2023 revival, not a direct Dreamcast remake.

entries.title: Samba de Amigo: Party-To-Go

emulation.notes: Capture from a compatible Apple device if covering its story mode.

primary.why: Party-To-Go is the Apple Arcade version and has series-exclusive story content plus exclusive songs documented separately from the Switch and Quest releases.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Apple Arcade version on a compatible Apple device, ideally with a controller/capture setup suited to the device. Play it after Party Central if you only want the story-mode and exclusive-song differences.

all_releases.fidelity: Apple Arcade release for Apple's subscription ecosystem.
all_releases.reason: primary: only official route for the Party-To-Go story-mode version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Party-To-Go's story mode and exclusive songs make it its own Apple Arcade route.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is the Apple Arcade version with story-mode/exclusive-song differences, not a direct port of Party Central.
